title: NPDev artifact provenance index (npdev-provenance-index.v1)
description: S14 (NPDEV_MEGA_ROADMAP.md, Track B). The spec-node -> emitted-artifact map model-xref.json never had: for each persisted concept, which generated Spring classes, which schema/DB migration statement, and which frontend route were actually produced from it. Produced by com.npdev.generator.provenance.ProvenanceIndexEmitter, which the generator emits into each app as npdev/provenance-index.json, alongside npdev/model-xref.json in the same directory and under the same versioning discipline (an explicit `schemaVersion` const, deterministic emission hashed by scripts/hygiene/check-deterministic-generation.ps1). Artifact discovery is convention-based over the emitted output root; a file that does not exist is omitted, never fabricated. Join key: a `specNodes` key is a concept name spelled exactly as model-xref.json's `edges[].toName` spells it for a `toKind: "concept"` edge (or as box-manifest.json's `boxes[].graphName` spells it for a box with `graphKind: "concept"`) -- the three documents describe the same node under the same name, so a consumer can join them without renormalizing anything. Consumers: Session 15's impact graph explorer and Session 16's blast-radius/migration-plan join, both walking this index alongside model-xref.json's semantic edges.

specNodes.description: One entry per persisted concept, keyed by the concept's qualified name (the same join key model-xref.json and box-manifest.json use for a concept node). Insertion-ordered by that name, ascending -- the order is part of the contract: this file is emitted into every generated app and hashed across two generator runs by scripts/hygiene/check-deterministic-generation.ps1.

nodeCount.description: Always equal to the number of keys in `specNodes` -- lets a consumer size the index without walking it.

kind.description: The only spec-node kind this index covers today. Same vocabulary as model-xref.json's `toKind`/`fromKind` and box-manifest.json's `graphKind`.

table.description: The concept's realized table name, as com.npdev.dsl.v1.compiled.SqlIdentifierSupport.tableName computes it -- what the schema-migration artifact's CREATE TABLE statement (when present) actually names.

artifacts.description: Every artifact this generation run actually produced from the concept, sorted by `type` then `path`. A kind of artifact this concept has no instance of (e.g. no jdbc schema-realization script was emitted at all) is simply absent -- never a placeholder entry.

type.description: The kind of emitted artifact. `generated-class` covers every generated Spring class derived from the concept (entity, DTOs, service, controller); `schema-migration` is the Flyway V1 schema-realization script carrying this concept's CREATE TABLE; `frontend-route` is the generated UI manifest entry for the concept's route.

path.description: Path to the artifact, relative to the generated app's root (the same root npdev/model-xref.json and npdev/box-manifest.json are written under).

digest.description: SHA-256 of the artifact's emitted bytes at the time this index was written, so a consumer can detect drift between the index and the file on disk without re-deriving the whole tree.

note.description: Optional human-readable detail distinguishing this artifact instance -- the literal CREATE TABLE statement for a schema-migration artifact, the literal route for a frontend-route artifact. Absent for artifact types (generated-class) where the path alone is unambiguous.
